resources.string: Shared places appear on the map for all drivers, under your pseudonym.
Takes about 2 seconds. It looks only at what you write, never at who you are.
Until then it shows \"Not verified yet\". Accurate places raise your level.
Shops, stalls, surau, workshops, parking and places to stop. No homes, adverts or job offers. Want it only for yourself? Choose \"Just for me\": it never leaves your phone.
Shared places get a quick automatic check, then people nearby confirm them.
Checking before it goes on the map…
Is this a real place drivers can visit?
Usually about 2 seconds. You can close this: the result also arrives in your Inbox.
Drivers can find it in search now. The next person who stops nearby will be asked \"Is this place here?\". When they say yes, it becomes Community verified and you get +20 points.
You can edit it while it\'s not verified yet. An edit is checked again.
The automatic check didn\'t run this time. Drivers nearby will be asked to confirm it before it shows in search.
Your Emas level means it skips the wait. It still passed the same automatic check. Now and then we ask a driver nearby to confirm an Emas place, to keep everyone\'s level fair.
If the automatic check is unsure about an Emas place, a person decides. It is never refused automatically.
Is it already on the map?
We found a similar place %1$s from your pin. You wrote \"%2$s\".
We found a similar place near your pin. You wrote \"%1$s\".
Yes, that\'s it: suggest an edit
No, mine is a different place
\"Different place\" sends it on with that answer. If the check still thinks it\'s the same, a person decides. Nothing is lost either way.
A person will check this one
Why: the description mentions security details (cameras, guard times). We never publish those, but the place itself may be fine. A maintainer may remove that sentence and publish the rest.
Why: it may be the same as a place already on the map. A maintainer compares them.
Why: the automatic check wasn\'t sure about it. That doesn\'t mean anything is wrong.
You asked for a review. A Manotu maintainer, a person, answers within 24 hours.
Until then only you can see it. You\'ll get the answer in your Inbox.
New contributors see this more often: until you have 3 accepted places, anything the check isn\'t sure about goes to a person.

Manotu places are locations drivers can visit. We don\'t accept adverts, investment offers, job offers or promotions. It was not published, and nobody else saw it.
It reads like an offer that asks people for money or personal details. We don\'t publish those. It was not published, and nobody else saw it.
We don\'t publish places that sell illegal or unregistered goods or services. It was not published, and nobody else saw it.
We don\'t publish adult services. It was not published, and nobody else saw it.
The name or description doesn\'t read as a place drivers can find. It was not published, and nobody else saw it.
The automatic check didn\'t accept it. It was not published, and nobody else saw it.
Is there a real shop or office here? Edit the name to what\'s on the signboard and describe the place, not the offer.
I think this is wrong: ask for a review
A person reviewed it, and it stays unpublished.
This looks like it\'s about a person

To protect people\'s privacy, we don\'t publish private homes for everyone. You can still keep it on the map for yourself. A \"Just for me\" place stays on this phone and in your own backup, and never reaches Manotu.

To protect people\'s privacy, we don\'t publish places that name or point at a person. You can still keep it on the map for yourself. A \"Just for me\" place stays on this phone and in your own backup, and never reaches Manotu.
It\'s a business: ask for a review
Home businesses (kuih, tailors, homestays) are welcome. Name the business, not the person, and add opening hours.
